From the text, U2 = 10 V RMS. Convert mentally to the available peak √2×10 ≈ 14.1 V, then account qualitatively for diode conduction and ripple in a normally loaded capacitor-filter rectifier, giving the standard practical estimate U_L ≈ 1.2U2 rather than the ideal peak. Therefore use 1.2 × 10 V and obtain 12 V.
